div.p: When enabled there are three layers: INSERT (typing), field NORMAL (vim in finding details / comments), and NAV (move between findings). Esc leaves INSERT but stays in the field; Esc again goes to NAV. o types a letter in INSERT, opens a line in field NORMAL, and sets status Open only in NAV. {/} are paragraphs in the field and previous/next finding in NAV. Tab / Shift+Tab (or gt/gT in field NORMAL) moves between finding details and comments. Finding details and comments still require Save / Ctrl+s (or :w when vim is on). You can also click the VIM OFF / NORMAL badge in the editor toolbar.
Workspaces, STIG baselines, and HEC ingest settings are on the UCC Configuration page. This classic view only toggles vim shortcuts for the classic editor.
